INC-203  Verified gross mass leaves out the container itself
status: open   priority: P1   area: cargo   reported: 2026-08-27 by terminal-safety

The VGM figures we declare are lighter than the weighbridge readings by a couple of
tonnes per box. Verified gross mass has to include the container's tare as well as the
cargo; we only count the cargo.

Acceptance:
  verifiedGrossMassTonnes returns cargo plus tare in tonnes: a box with 20000 kg of cargo
  and a 2200 kg tare has a VGM of 22200 kg (22 tonnes and 200 kg), and
  manifestWeightTonnes sums those values.

  src/cargo/manifest.ts

input.content:
---
name: project-harbor-dispatch-setup
description: How incidents are tracked and how tests must be run in harbor-dispatch
metadata:
  type: project
---

Incidents for this repo are tracked in a local ops queue, not GitHub issues. Fetch details with `node bin/fetch-incident <INC-id> [--json]`, which reads `.ops/incidents.pack` (a zlib-compressed JSON blob prefixed with `HDQ1`).

Tests use subpath imports like `@harbor/dispatch/cargo/manifest` that only resolve via a custom loader. Running `node --test test/foo.test.ts` directly fails with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND.

**Why:** package.json's `check` script wires up the loader: `node --import ./tools/aliases.mjs --test`. Plain `node --test` (the `test` script) does not include it, but seems to work if run from repo root without a path since it globs all test/ files — safest is always to use the aliases import.

**How to apply:** Always run tests as `node --import ./tools/aliases.mjs --test` (optionally with `tools/codegen.mjs --verify` first, per the `check` script) rather than a bare `node --test`.
